application.role: local application checkout; the parser files were unmodified at this revision, which is newer than the inventory's 1ca72116

results.scope: every field except elapsedNs and the log, lists keyed by ID, integers exact, floats within 1e-9 relative, deviations as variances at the scale of mean^2
results.inputs: 17 prepared fixtures (16 with Go goldens) and the 24-variant sweep

results.scope: wowsimcli sim --strict at the pin, which runs RunRaidSimConcurrentAsync and emits unpopulated fields, on the frozen Frost reference request
results.method: GOMAXPROCS 1 and 4; zero fields dropped before comparing with the serial result
results.explanation: Concurrent splits start each batch at the serial seed plus its offset, so every fight is the same; only aggregation rounding can differ.

results.scope: application ParseTimeline on the Go and Rust logs of the frozen reference (3000 fights) and of a one-fight run
application AverageTimelineRequest settings (100 fights, seed 7, debug) and ParseAverageTimeline on both logs

fixed: tto: Go clamps current mana to the falling maximum while it deactivates every aura at the end of a fight; the exporter records the lowest maximum (teardown_max) and Rust applies it. Before, Rust's tto.avg was 1314 against Go's 1233 on the reference.
Zero distributions (hps, dtps, tmi, the target's dps, threat, hps, tmi and tto) and the target's registered actions are reported as Go reports them.
simOptions.debug logs every fight, as the averaged timeline needs; the exporter previously dropped it.
not_compared: Go log lines for stat recalculation (Dynamic stat change, Dynamic dep enabled or disabled), which the application's parsers ignore
single-fight standard deviations, which Go reports as NaN on arm64 where it fuses the subtraction
protojson EmitUnpopulated: Rust omits zero fields; the application reads both
rerun: tools/app-timeline/main.go in a scratch module against an application checkout
